name: gpt-engineer

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key. gpt-engineer is GPT-tuned and won't run without it.

MODEL_NAME.description: Override default model. Defaults to gpt-4o.

PROJECT_PATH.description: Project directory to scaffold into. Defaults to a tmp dir per invocation.

notes: Codegen-from-spec agent. Best at greenfield scaffolding from a natural-language brief; weaker at editing existing repos. Defaults to ADVISOR tier so generated files are reviewed before write-out.
